name: OMEPRAZOLE / SODIUM BICARBONATE 20/1100MG 30 CAPSULES
description: The combination of omeprazole and sodium bicarbonate in 20/1100 mg capsules is used to treat disorders related to excess stomach acid, such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and heartburn. Sodium bicarbonate acts as an immediate antacid, while omeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI), suppresses acid production over the long term. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
